DRC_disposition.detail: Adjacent native package pads:0.150mm actual vs0.200mm current rule. Rules have not been relaxed.
Thermal holes:0.200mm drill vs0.300mm current minimum. Fabricator/assembler capability and process must be selected before qualifying rules.

step_frame_comparison_scope: Raw kernel bounding boxes only, including native tolerance. All bounds unchanged to0.0001mm; no surface-equivalence assertion.
top_view_review: Actual KiCad render visually inspected: bodies inside outline, both mounting holes accessible in projection. Does not verify plugs, solder fillets or3D enclosure clearance.
source_guard: All source schematic/project/preview hashes unchanged during final build and after CLI checks. Deliberate schematic assignments were separately backed up in provisional-footprints-verification.json.
known_gates: U201 TI DSJ thermal via and stencil process must be accepted by the assembler.
J301 connector pitch/mating geometry unverified; J402 scaled SMA visual is not real SMB CAD.
L101 and L701 current/package choices need exact orderable parts; sizes not reduced.
Through-hole lead tails require carrier relief and actual solder/protrusion checks.
Placement uses actual courtyards but is not a routed power-loop, thermal, EMI or analogue review.
Real harness plugs, wire bends and tall-component enclosure clearance require assembly checks.
